assertions.detail: emissions/reference branch area, vertical metric, pressure, and density are bitwise identical
assertions.name: paired_meteorology_identity

assertions.detail: every species reports the unqualified pressure <150 hPa column separately
assertions.name: upper_column_exposed

assertions.name: passed_promotable_same_provenance_inputs

above_150_hpa.interpretation: unqualified upper column; stability checks only

lower_troposphere.interpretation: lower and middle troposphere at or below about 500 hPa

interpretation.purpose: physical validity and broad concentration plausibility screening
interpretation.spinup: all F3 branches share one day of FS spin-up with CAMS-NOx emissions; this initializes fast partitioning but not long-lived chemical climatology
interpretation.upper_column: stability only; chemistry is not qualified above the 150 hPa diagnostic boundary

global_o3.benchmark: Observation-calibrated global modeling gives about 29.2 ppb mean surface O3 and 53.2 ppb at 500 hPa.

global_oh.benchmark: Published global models span 0.87-1.28 million molecule cm-3 for volume-weighted mean tropospheric OH.

noaa_air_composition.benchmark: NOAA gives dry-air O2 at 20.936%, CH4 near 2 ppm, other trace species below 1 ppm, and a representative wet-air case with 3% H2O.

noaa_ch4.benchmark: NOAA global marine-boundary-layer CH4 was 1929.56 +/- 0.61 ppb in 2024.

peroxides.benchmark: Aircraft campaign means for H2O2, CH3OOH, and CH2O were about 1.39, 0.44, and 0.48 ppb in the most enhanced campaign.

remote_nox.benchmark: NASA free-tropospheric medians were tens of ppt for NO and NO2; the screening ceiling allows polluted source cells.
